notes.title: NEW LIFE | Update 1.0.4
notes.content:
Hello, we have just updated the game with some bug fixes and a new feature. We wanted to add more tasks to the Police Job, so we made that the AI can now rob the Super Market. Our next update will be the bank heist. Hope you enjoy the new update and please report all the bugs you find on our discord server. Thank you very much to all the people that has been helping us to find all the bugs.

notes.title: NEW FEATURES | Update 1.0.3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34275636/e54ed38eb640a570c964eb1535d484fc296ddaae.jpg[/img]

Hello, first of all we wanted to apologize for not updating the game a such a long time. We have been working on the game and now we are happy to announce that we have just updated the game with new features.

With the new update you can work as a police officer and make sure the town remains a safe place. On the other hand, if you want to earn money fast you can rob liquor stores or cultive drugs. We have also changed the shooting and driving system and also added a Voice chat system so players can finally communicate. We hope you like the new update and if you find a bug, please send us a message either by discord or with an email reporting it.

New Important Features:
- New map
- Voice chat
- Police job
- Rob liquor store
- New car
- Sound improvement
- Rob gangs (AI)
- New shooting system
- New driving system

Restart Steam If you don't get the update.
